answer: Resist sybils by making reputation expensive to build and worthless to copy. A newcomer earns standing only through work that established peers attest — nectar gathered drop by drop, not poured in at once. To forge a second identity, a farm must redo all that attested work from zero, paying full price per head. The bridge is the attestation graph: trust flows along verified work, so an identity with no bridge to established peers stays outside the paid set, however many copies it spawns.
